notes.title: 🚀 First Showcase! Orebits at Courage Cologne during DevCom 2025
notes.content:
Our first ever showcase is here! 🎉


On August 19th, we’ll be at Courage Cologne during DevCom 2025 in Köln, Germany. This will be the very first time Orebits is shown publicly. We couldn’t be more excited to share it with you!

We’re bringing a fresh demo build for the event, and the flyers, shirts and stand decorations are coming in! Here’s a peek:




[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674717/5ca5ca7d20d62e2a77966df1e978d8cc83d4cef2.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674717/48272898598745174155fbdbd3f6f9b3a59f0179.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674717/8ab5143360398ef04f0cb3077619841c2ba129d7.jpg"][/carousel]


This showcase and 'real' physical stuff makes our game dev journey even more 'real'!


GamesCom

We’ll also be walking the floors at GamesCom on Thursday to soak in all the gaming goodness.

If you’re showcasing or visiting DevCom or GamesCom and want to meet up: drop a comment below! We’d love to meet fellow devs, gamers, and anyone curious about Orebits.



See you in Germany!

notes.title: Orebits has a Steam page! What a nice milestone :)
notes.content:
Orebits is live on Steam!
Adding a storepage for Orebits is a big milestone to check off our (big) to do list! It takes a lot of work to build a nice Steam page: research, copywriting, capsules, screenshots, trailer, gifs, feature lists, and much more.


But we have made it! 


We hope that you enjoy our Steam page and please let us know if you have any suggestions to improve it.



And of course: a wishlist would help us out so much!



Thanks for being here!
